segments.text: Welcome to this explainer.
segments.zh: 欢迎收看本期讲解。

segments.text: Look, today we're tearing down that wall of panic
segments.zh: 今天，我们要拆掉那堵通常围绕着

segments.text: that usually surrounds regulatory inspections.
segments.zh: 监管检查的恐慌之墙。

segments.text: We're gonna dive into the source material
segments.zh: 我们将深入研读资料，

segments.text: and show you how staying ready every single day
segments.zh: 向你展示每天都保持就绪状态

segments.text: isn't just about compliance.
segments.zh: 不仅仅关乎合规。

segments.text: It's actually a massive operational advantage.
segments.zh: 它实际上是一项巨大的运营优势。

segments.text: Whether OSHA, the FDA, or any accreditation body is knocking,
segments.zh: 无论是 OSHA、FDA 还是任何认证机构来敲门，

segments.text: we want you to be ready.
segments.zh: 我们都希望你已经准备好了。

segments.text: So let's jump right in.
segments.zh: 那我们直接开始吧。

segments.text: Now, I want you to be honest for a second.
segments.zh: 现在，我希望你诚实地想一下。

segments.text: When an inspector arrives, do you panic?
segments.zh: 当检查员到来时，你会慌吗？

segments.text: Do you feel that sudden drop in your stomach?
segments.zh: 你会不会突然心里一沉？

segments.text: If you or your team are feeling that kind of episodic panic,
segments.zh: 如果你或你的团队有这种阶段性的恐慌，

segments.text: it probably means you're treating the inspection
segments.zh: 那很可能说明你把检查

segments.text: as the main event.
segments.zh: 当成了主场大戏。

segments.text: In reality, it should just be a dress rehearsal.
segments.zh: 实际上，它应该只是一次彩排。

segments.text: The truth is, the only things that matter when they walk in
segments.zh: 事实是，当他们走进来时，唯一重要的

segments.text: are the records and the rhythm you built
segments.zh: 是你早在他们出现之前

segments.text: way before they ever showed up.
segments.zh: 就建立起来的记录和节奏。

segments.text: Panic is basically just a symptom of treating readiness
segments.zh: 恐慌基本上只是一个症状，说明你把就绪

segments.text: as a one-off event instead of a permanent posture.
segments.zh: 当成了一次性事件，而不是一种常态。

segments.text: To really grasp the stakes here,
segments.zh: 为了真正理解其中的利害，

segments.text: let's look at this absolutely wild citation cascade
segments.zh: 我们来看看资料中这个

segments.text: from the data.
segments.zh: 令人咋舌的连环处罚案例。

segments.text: Back in 2018, a pharma facility got hit
segments.zh: 早在 2018 年，一家制药厂

segments.text: with six minor OSHA safety citations.
segments.zh: 收到了六项轻微的 OSHA 安全违规传票。

segments.text: No big deal, right?
segments.zh: 没什么大不了的，对吧？

segments.text: They paid a small fine,
segments.zh: 他们交了一小笔罚款，

segments.text: but they didn't actually fix the root causes.
segments.zh: 但并没有真正解决根本原因。

segments.text: Fast forward to 2022, and those minor issues
segments.zh: 到了 2022 年，这些小问题

segments.text: had escalated into willful citations
segments.zh: 已经升级为故意违规传票，

segments.text: with a staggering $1.8 million proposed penalty.
segments.zh: 拟处罚款高达惊人的 180 万美元。

segments.text: Yeah, $1.8 million.
segments.zh: 没错，180 万美元。

segments.text: It just goes to show that minor safety findings,
segments.zh: 这正说明，轻微的安全问题

segments.text: when you ignore them, can quickly snowball
segments.zh: 一旦被忽视，就会迅速像滚雪球一样

segments.text: into an absolute organizational nightmare.
segments.zh: 演变成组织的一场噩梦。

segments.text: So how do we avoid that kind of cascade?
segments.zh: 那么我们如何避免这种连锁反应呢？

segments.text: The sources break it down into five key pillars.
segments.zh: 资料把它分解为五大关键支柱。

segments.text: We're gonna cover, one, the daily readiness mindset.
segments.zh: 我们要讲的是：第一，每日就绪的心态。

segments.text: Two, documentation, your first offense.
segments.zh: 第二，文件记录，你的第一道防线。

segments.text: Three, self-inspections and mock audits.
segments.zh: 第三，自查和模拟审核。

segments.text: Four, corrective actions and kappa.
segments.zh: 第四，纠正措施与 CAPA。

segments.text: And lastly, five, the everyday readiness rhythm.
segments.zh: 最后，第五，日常就绪节奏。

segments.text: Let's kick things off with section one,
segments.zh: 我们从第一部分开始，

segments.text: the daily readiness mindset.
segments.zh: 每日就绪的心态。

segments.text: The sources make it super clear.
segments.zh: 资料说得非常清楚。

segments.text: We have to fundamentally shift away
segments.zh: 我们必须从根本上摆脱

segments.text: from chaotic, episodic preparation.
segments.zh: 混乱的、临时突击式的准备。

segments.text: You know the drill, right?
segments.zh: 你懂的，对吧？

segments.text: Scrambling around, updating binders
segments.zh: 手忙脚乱地四处奔走，在最后一刻

segments.text: at the absolute last minute
segments.zh: 更新文件夹，

segments.text: because someone heard a rumor and inspector was coming.
segments.zh: 只因为有人听到传言说检查员要来了。

segments.text: Instead, highly mature programs
segments.zh: 相反，高度成熟的安全计划

segments.text: build what we call a daily posture.
segments.zh: 会建立我们所说的“日常常态”。

segments.text: Meaning, when an unannounced inspection inevitably happens,
segments.zh: 意思是，当不可避免的突击检查到来时，

segments.text: those regulators are just walking into a system
segments.zh: 监管人员走进的是一个

segments.text: that's literally in audit mode every single day.
segments.zh: 每一天都实实在在处于审核状态的体系。

segments.text: There's this fantastic piece of advice in the text
segments.zh: 资料里有一条非常棒的建议，

segments.text: that really stuck with me.
segments.zh: 让我印象深刻。

segments.text: Plan for the inspection 25 years from now.
segments.zh: 要为 25 年后的检查做准备。

segments.text: This isn't just about surviving today's visit.
segments.zh: 这不只是为了熬过今天的检查。

segments.text: Think about it.
segments.zh: 想一想。

segments.text: An inspector requires exposure
segments.zh: 检查方要求暴露记录

segments.text: and medical surveillance records
segments.zh: 和医学监护记录

segments.text: to be kept for 30 years post-employment.
segments.zh: 在雇佣关系结束后保存 30 年。

segments.text: An inspector could casually ask
segments.zh: 检查员可能随口就要

segments.text: for documents from decades ago.
segments.zh: 几十年前的文件。

segments.text: This totally forces your hand
segments.zh: 这就逼得你必须在今天

segments.text: to build incredibly durable, robust digital systems today.
segments.zh: 建立起极其持久、稳健的数字化系统。

segments.text: All right, moving right along to section two,
segments.zh: 好，接下来是第二部分，

segments.text: documentation, your first defense.
segments.zh: 文件记录，你的第一道防线。

segments.text: When you actually look at the retention requirements,
segments.zh: 当你真正去看保存期限要求时，

segments.text: they are all over the map.
segments.zh: 会发现它们五花八门。

segments.text: I mean, exposure records demand 30 years.
segments.zh: 我是说，暴露记录要求保存 30 年。

segments.text: OSHA 300 injury logs.
segments.zh: OSHA 300 伤害记录表，

segments.text: Those need five years.
segments.zh: 需要保存五年。

segments.text: EPA-RCRA hazardous waste manifest require three years,
segments.zh: EPA RCRA 危险废物转移联单要求保存三年，

segments.text: and FDA-GMP records generally need at least five years,
segments.zh: 而 FDA GMP 记录一般至少需要保存五年，

segments.text: or lot expiry plus one.
segments.zh: 或者批次有效期再加一年。

segments.text: You absolutely cannot manage this kind of variety
segments.zh: 你绝对不可能靠一个乱糟糟、

segments.text: with some messy, overflowing filing cabinet.
segments.zh: 塞得满满的文件柜来管理这么多种要求。

segments.text: Let me give you a really cool,
segments.zh: 我给你举一个资料中

segments.text: real-world example from the text.
segments.zh: 非常酷的真实案例。

segments.text: So, in a 2024 inspection,
segments.zh: 在 2024 年的一次检查中，

segments.text: regulators asked for baseline exposure
segments.zh: 监管人员要求提供一名分析员 2018 年的

segments.text: and medical records for an analyst from 2018.
segments.zh: 基线暴露记录和医疗记录。

segments.text: Because this specific site had dedicated themselves
segments.zh: 由于这个厂区此前全力投入

segments.text: to a massive paper to digital migration,
segments.zh: 大规模的纸质转数字化迁移，

segments.text: they didn't just find the 2018 records.
segments.zh: 他们不仅找到了 2018 年的记录，

segments.text: Within a single hour,
segments.zh: 还在短短一个小时内，

segments.text: they produced records dating all the way back to 1995.
segments.zh: 调出了最早可追溯到 1995 年的记录。

segments.text: Talk about a flex.
segments.zh: 这可真是够秀的。

segments.text: That success story proves that the upfront investment
segments.zh: 这个成功案例证明，前期在整理和数字化上的投入

segments.text: in organizing and digitizing pays off big time.
segments.zh: 会带来巨大的回报。

segments.text: Handing an inspector exactly what they want,
segments.zh: 这么快就把检查员想要的东西准确地交到他手里，

segments.text: that fast, sets an immediate tone of total competence.
segments.zh: 立刻就树立了一种全面胜任的基调。

segments.text: Now, there's a really tricky overlap area
segments.zh: 现在，有一个非常棘手的交叉领域

segments.text: you need to watch out for.
segments.zh: 需要你特别留意。

segments.text: When a safety event also impacts quality.
segments.zh: 那就是安全事件同时影响到质量的情况。

segments.text: Say, an analyst gets exposed to an active ingredient
segments.zh: 比如，一名分析员在检测过程中

segments.text: during a test.
segments.zh: 接触到了活性成分。

segments.text: Mature labs follow a golden rule here.
segments.zh: 成熟的实验室在这里遵循一条黄金法则。

segments.text: One investigation, two reports.
segments.zh: 一次调查，两份报告。

segments.text: Instead of running separate,
segments.zh: 他们不会分别开展

segments.text: completely siloed investigations
segments.zh: 完全各自为政、

segments.text: that might end up contradicting each other,
segments.zh: 最后可能相互矛盾的调查，

segments.text: they use one unified analysis.
segments.zh: 而是采用一次统一的分析。

segments.text: From that, they generate an FDA deviation report
segments.zh: 在此基础上，生成一份 FDA 偏差报告

segments.text: and an OSHA injury report that align perfectly.
segments.zh: 和一份 OSHA 伤害报告，两者完全一致。

segments.text: Because let me tell you,
segments.zh: 因为我告诉你，

segments.text: contradictory records are highly inspectable
segments.zh: 相互矛盾的记录非常容易被检查发现，

segments.text: and incredibly damaging.
segments.zh: 而且杀伤力极大。

segments.text: You really don't want to pay twice
segments.zh: 你肯定不想为同一个错误

segments.text: for the exact same mistake.
segments.zh: 付出两次代价。

segments.text: Next up, section three, self-inspections and mock audits.
segments.zh: 接下来，第三部分，自查和模拟审核。

segments.text: This right here is the ultimate dress rehearsal framework.
segments.zh: 这就是终极的彩排框架。

segments.text: It's all about building a cumulative rhythm.
segments.zh: 关键在于建立一种层层累积的节奏。

segments.text: You start simple, weekly EHS walks using a checklist.
segments.zh: 从简单的开始，每周用检查清单进行 EHS 巡查。

segments.text: That rolls naturally into quarterly self-audits
segments.zh: 这自然而然会延伸到每季度

segments.text: against your full requirements.
segments.zh: 对照全部要求进行自我审核。

segments.text: Then you bring in semi-annual third-party assessments
segments.zh: 然后每半年引入一次第三方评估，

segments.text: just to get some fresh unbiased eyes on the lab.
segments.zh: 用不带偏见的新视角来审视实验室。

segments.text: And finally, you run an annual full-blown mock inspection.
segments.zh: 最后，每年进行一次全面的模拟检查。

segments.text: By the time the actual regulators show up,
segments.zh: 等到真正的监管人员来时，

segments.text: your system has literally been pressure tested
segments.zh: 你的体系已经从各个能想到的角度

segments.text: from every conceivable angle.
segments.zh: 经受过压力测试了。

segments.text: Let's zoom in on that annual mock inspection for a second.
segments.zh: 我们来仔细看看这个年度模拟检查。

segments.text: The crucial make or break takeaway here
segments.zh: 这里决定成败的关键要点是，

segments.text: is that you must remediate all findings
segments.zh: 你必须把所有发现的问题

segments.text: as if they were 100% real.
segments.zh: 当作百分之百真实的问题来整改。

segments.text: Running this drill is an amazing way
segments.zh: 开展这种演练是一个绝佳的方法，

segments.text: to expose hidden document gaps,
segments.zh: 可以暴露隐藏的文件缺口，

segments.text: see if your designated inspector escorts start improvising,
segments.zh: 看看你指定的检查陪同人员会不会开始即兴发挥，

segments.text: which you do not want,
segments.zh: 这是你不希望看到的，

segments.text: and find any little cracks in your safety culture
segments.zh: 还能在真正面临风险之前，

segments.text: way before the stakes are real.
segments.zh: 发现安全文化中的任何细小裂缝。

segments.text: Which brings us to section four,
segments.zh: 这就引出了第四部分，

segments.text: corrective actions and kappa.
segments.zh: 纠正措施与 CAPA。

segments.text: This four-step lifecycle of a finding
segments.zh: 一个检查发现项的四步生命周期

segments.text: is a classic closed loop system.
segments.zh: 是一个典型的闭环系统。

segments.text: You've got the observation, the root cause analysis,
segments.zh: 包括观察发现、根本原因分析、

segments.text: the corrective action,
segments.zh: 纠正措施，

segments.text: and then effectiveness verification.
segments.zh: 然后是有效性验证。

segments.text: I really wanna emphasize that last one.
segments.zh: 我特别想强调最后这一步。

segments.text: Missing that final step,
segments.zh: 漏掉这最后一步，

segments.text: actually checking to make sure your action
segments.zh: 也就是实际检查你的措施

segments.text: prevented the issue from happening again
segments.zh: 是否防止了问题再次发生，

segments.text: is easily the number one most common mistake.
segments.zh: 无疑是排名第一的最常见错误。

segments.text: Honestly, dropping the ball on effectiveness verification
segments.zh: 说实话，在有效性验证上掉链子，

segments.text: is exactly how you end up with those repeat incidents
segments.zh: 正是导致那些重复事故的原因，

segments.text: that trigger the massive penalties we talked about earlier.
segments.zh: 进而招致我们前面谈到的巨额罚款。

segments.text: Speed and strategy are huge here.
segments.zh: 速度和策略在这里至关重要。

segments.text: When the FDA hands you a Form 483,
segments.zh: 当 FDA 给你一份 483 表，

segments.text: which is their official list of inspectional observations,
segments.zh: 也就是他们正式的检查观察项清单时，

segments.text: you generally have exactly 15 working days
segments.zh: 你一般只有整整 15 个工作日

segments.text: to deliver a high-quality response.
segments.zh: 来提交一份高质量的回复。

segments.text: That's the industry standard.
segments.zh: 这是行业标准。

segments.text: If you miss that 15-day window,
segments.zh: 如果你错过了这 15 天的期限，

segments.text: or if you hand in some weak response
segments.zh: 或者交上去的回复很敷衍，

segments.text: with no firm kappa dates,
segments.zh: 没有明确的 CAPA 日期，

segments.text: you are on the absolute fast track
segments.zh: 那你就是直奔

segments.text: to a very public warning letter.
segments.zh: 一封公开的警告信而去了。

segments.text: So we've got to completely reframe our mindset around audits.
segments.zh: 所以我们必须彻底转变对审核的看法。

segments.text: Spotting a gap during your own self-audit,
segments.zh: 在自己的自我审核中发现缺口，

segments.text: that is not a failure.
segments.zh: 那不是失败。

segments.text: That is a massive win.
segments.zh: 那是巨大的胜利。

segments.text: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.text: Because trend analysis lets you transform
segments.zh: 因为趋势分析能让你把

segments.text: isolated observations into actual systemic fixes.
segments.zh: 孤立的观察发现转化为真正的系统性改进。

segments.text: Let's say your quarterly trend analysis
segments.zh: 假设你的季度趋势分析

segments.text: spots that training documentation gaps are creeping up.
segments.zh: 发现培训记录方面的缺口在逐渐增加。

segments.text: That's brilliant data.
segments.zh: 这是非常宝贵的数据。

segments.text: You take that straight to leadership,
segments.zh: 你把它直接拿给领导层，

segments.text: secure the budget to upgrade
segments.zh: 争取到预算来升级

segments.text: your learning management system,
segments.zh: 你的学习管理系统，

segments.text: and you fix the root cause proactively.
segments.zh: 从而主动解决根本原因。

segments.text: We have to start viewing audits as an asset, not a liability.
segments.zh: 我们必须开始把审核视为一项资产，而不是负担。

segments.text: And finally, section five,
segments.zh: 最后，第五部分，

segments.text: the everyday readiness rhythm.
segments.zh: 日常就绪节奏。

segments.text: So pulling it all together,
segments.zh: 综合起来看，

segments.text: what does a highly mature program
segments.zh: 一个高度成熟的安全计划

segments.text: actually look like on the ground?
segments.zh: 在实际工作中究竟是什么样子？

segments.text: Well, it means your written programs are current, signed,
segments.zh: 嗯，这意味着你的书面计划是最新的、经过签署的，

segments.text: and you can retrieve them in minutes.
segments.zh: 而且几分钟内就能调取出来。

segments.text: Your training records actually prove competency,
segments.zh: 你的培训记录真正证明了能力，

segments.text: not just that someone sat in a chair.
segments.zh: 而不只是证明某人在椅子上坐过。

segments.text: Your kappa system is actively investigating near misses.
segments.zh: 你的 CAPA 系统正在积极调查未遂事件。

segments.text: Ultimately, mastering these daily practices
segments.zh: 归根结底，掌握这些日常做法

segments.text: means your workforce stops viewing audits
segments.zh: 意味着你的员工不再把审核

segments.text: as this looming threat
segments.zh: 看作一种迫在眉睫的威胁，

segments.text: and starts seeing them as an opportunity
segments.zh: 而是开始把它视为

segments.text: for collaborative learning.
segments.zh: 协作学习的机会。

segments.text: As we wrap up this explainer,
segments.zh: 在本期讲解结束之际，

segments.text: I want you to take a hard, critical look
segments.zh: 我希望你认真、批判性地审视

segments.text: at your own operations.
segments.zh: 你自己的运营。

segments.text: Ask yourself, are your daily rhythms actually robust enough
segments.zh: 问问自己，你的日常节奏是否真的足够稳健，

segments.text: to make an unannounced inspection completely uneventful?
segments.zh: 能让一次突击检查变得完全波澜不惊？

segments.text: Or are you just crossing your fingers
segments.zh: 还是你只是在祈祷，

segments.text: and hoping they don't knock on your door today?
segments.zh: 希望他们今天别来敲你的门？

segments.text: Remember, readiness isn't an event you prepare for.
segments.zh: 记住，就绪不是一个你去准备的事件。

segments.text: It's a posture you live out every single day.
segments.zh: 它是你每一天都践行的一种常态。
